name: App icon hero
oneLiner: the brand's app icon drops in as a thick glossy 3D tile with a glass bevel, bounces on a glass floor with its reflection, a light sweep runs over it, the name and a line settle under it and a notification badge pops and counts up
say: when the speaker names the app or tells people to download it: the icon lands on the name, the badge pops on 'it's already waiting for you' or a number
